experiment.name: case_study
experiment.description: Chinese consumer vehicle energy-type preferences: a two-stage LLM pipeline produces the corpus, the mixture of Section 2 analyses it

_note: Sections below this line document how the corpus was produced. No script in the repository reads them: the analysis starts at case_study/energy_pairs.jsonl. The three keys the code does read are energy_type_mapping, canonical_types and stage2_llm.dimensions, through common/paths.py.

stage1_transformer.model_path_note: a local artifact of the extraction pipeline, not part of this repository

architecture.encoder: RoBERTa-wwm-ext (12 layers, 768 hidden, Chinese whole-word masking)
architecture.head: Dropout(0.1) → Linear(768→64) → GELU → Dropout(0.1) → Linear(64→1) → sigmoid

dimension_labels.cost: 成本 — purchase price, fuel/charging cost, maintenance
dimension_labels.driving_experience: 驾驶体验 — NVH, acceleration, engine noise, driving quality
dimension_labels.range: 续航 — range capability, range anxiety, long-distance suitability
dimension_labels.refueling_convenience: 补能便利 — charging/refueling speed, infrastructure, home charging
dimension_labels.reliability: 可靠性 — technology maturity, durability, repair convenience
dimension_labels.policy: 政策 — license plate, tax exemption, road access
dimension_labels.other: 其他 — safety, smart features, design, brand, space

scoring_rubric.description: Fine-grained scores, 0.48–0.52 reserved for explicit ties
scoring_rubric.range_0_00_0_10: latter dominates across nearly all dimensions
scoring_rubric.range_0_15_0_30: latter clearly better on most dimensions
scoring_rubric.range_0_48_0_52: ONLY when article explicitly says tie/too close
scoring_rubric.range_0_70_0_85: former clearly better on most dimensions
scoring_rubric.range_0_90_1_00: former dominates across nearly all dimensions

files._note: energy_pairs.jsonl is committed and is where the analysis starts. The rest are inputs of the extraction pipeline that produced it; a fresh checkout will not have them.
